DML.SELECT: SELECT transit_attachment_id as "id", transit_id as "transitId", path as "path", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM rt.transit_attachments
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.transit_attachments ( transit_attachment_id, transit_id, path, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES( :id, :transitId, :path, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
